name: Local-Invoice-Parser
goal: Python CLI tool that scans a specified directory for image files (PNG, JPG) and PDF files. It uses a local OCR library (like pytesseract) to extract text, then applies regex rules to identify vendor, date, and amount fields. It outputs a structured CSV/JSON file and supports simple tax categorization rules. No external APIs or cloud sync.
acceptance_criteria: The tool scans a directory and extracts vendor, date, and amount using regex.
The tool outputs parsed data to CSV/JSON.
The tool handles both images and PDFs locally.
